facts.title: Vile Familiars: Summon Imp
facts.note: Level 2. Bring 6 Vile Familiar Heads to Ruzan to learn Summon Imp, then back to Zureetha.

facts.title: Voidwalker: Gan'rul's Summons, Creature of the Void, The Binding
facts.location: Ophek (Razor Hill), then Gan'rul Bloodeye (Cleft of Shadow)
facts.note: Level 10. Tablet of Verga is in the Burning Blade Stash in Skull Rock; summon at the Cleft of Shadow circle.

facts.title: Succubus (Sayaad) quest chain
facts.note: Level 20. Short travel chain: Orgrimmar, the Crossroads, Camp Taurajo, possibly Ratchet and Stonetalon (from your own beta run). Some Forever text calls the pet Sayaad.
